title: dev.qory.session.started
description: A session joined the run: its runtime is about to start. One per join that starts, after the gateway's join answer and before the session's process starts, and before any dev.qory.run.log, dev.qory.run.resized or runtime event of the session, whose events follow it up to its dev.qory.session.exited. A refused join, one the gateway answered with a 403 or that failed the session's checks, has no dev.qory.session.started, only its dev.qory.session.exited. Each of runtime, image, image_name and container_runtime that contains qak_ or qrk_ in any case is `(a name that contains an access key secret)` in its place, or `(a name that contains a run key)` when it contains qrk_ and no qak_. Each of dir, command, an argument, runtime_version and a word of preparation that contains one is `(a value that contains an access key secret)` or `(a value that contains a run key)` in the same way.

session.description: The session's number in the run, from 1: the session of the gateway's join answer. The gateway numbers the run's joins in the order their requests arrive.

runtime_version.description: The runtime version Forager's adapter for it, such as a descriptor, was written against; Forager never checks the installed version. Absent for a bare runtime, whose records the session does not parse, and when the runtime's adapter reports no version.

command.description: The program started, as the runtime prepared it.

args.description: Its arguments, as the runtime prepared them. Environment is never reported.

dir.description: The working directory the runtime starts in, as the enclosure sees it: under a wall at the same path as on the machine, and /workspace, or a directory under it, when the policy names the image by its reference pinned by digest. Without a wall command and dir are the machine's; with one they are the enclosure's.

preparation.description: The session's preparation, as the caller gave it: the program and then its arguments, which the session runs inside the wall before the runtime, in dir, with the runtime's environment and through the run's proxy. The runtime starts once it exits 0; a preparation that exits otherwise ends the session with its exit status, and the runtime never starts. command and args are then the script the session starts the runtime through, which runs the preparation first. Present when the run has a wall, absent otherwise.

interactive.description: True when the session runs on a pseudo-terminal, false on pipes.

terminal.description: The size of the pseudo-terminal the runtime starts on: Forager's terminal's when it has one, 80 by 24 otherwise. Present when interactive is true, absent on pipes. Every change after that is one dev.qory.run.resized.

image.description: The image the enclosure runs, the reference. Present when the run has a wall.

image_name.description: The machine's name for the image, when the image is one the machine defines: the one the policy selected, or the machine's default by name. Absent for an image the policy names by its reference. A name that contains qak_ or qrk_ in any case is one of two phrases in its place: the access key secret's when it contains qak_, else the run key's.

enum: (a name that contains an access key secret)
(a name that contains a run key)

container_runtime.description: The container runtime the wall started the image under, as the machine's definition sets it: sysbox-runc. Absent means the engine's default.

docker.description: True when the enclosure has nested Docker, a Docker daemon inside the wall, separate from the machine's, started by the wall before the runtime. Absent otherwise.

image_fetch_ms.description: How long the wall took to fetch the image, in milliseconds, when the policy names the image by its reference pinned by digest: before the session's runtime starts, the wall fetches such an image unless the engine holds it by that digest, and then records how long finding it took. Absent otherwise.

harness.description: The harness sources the session's compose used, one entry per source, when the caller passes them: each source as it is configured and the full commit id compose used. Forager copies them and reads nothing into them. Absent when the caller passes none; never empty.

source.description: The source as it is configured, such as https://git.example/example-org/harness#main.

commit.description: The full commit id compose used, 40 or 64 hexadecimal characters, in lower case.
